## Your rights in this transaction

| Check | Verified result | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contracted player or draft rights? | {{recorded status}} | {{existing contract assignment or transfer of signing rights}} |
| Player consent required? | {{yes / no / unresolved; exact contractual or agreement basis}} | {{show consent decision only when verified yes}} |
| New contract involved? | {{ordinary trade / proposed sign-and-trade / extension-and-trade}} | {{any new contract needs its own eligible negotiation and execution}} |

If no consent right applies, this is a notification and transition page. A preference, request or objection does not veto the club's trade. If the right is unresolved, verify it before representing the transaction as consent-free or final.

## What changes for you?

| Area | Before | After / still pending |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Team / reporting location | {{former club}} | {{receiving club; contact and reporting instruction}} |
| Contract | {{remaining salary and option terms}} | {{carried terms; separately verified bonus/rights effects}} |
| Role | {{previous communicated assignment}} | {{new coach's stated plan or meeting pending}} |
| Practical arrangements | {{current location}} | {{travel, housing support, physical and family needs}} |
| Statistical record | {{games already played for former club}} | {{retain that stint; new club games begin from their actual dates}} |

A trade does not automatically create a new contract, reset earned statistics or confer a starting job. Contract effects must come from the actual transaction and applicable rules.
